dedupe_keys.name: sup3rwind downscaled historical weather for ukraine and south america

description: The OEDI Sup3rWind submission provides downscaled historical wind and related weather fields for Ukraine, Moldova, part of Romania and South America. The public provider page identifies separate S3 folders for the two regions and an API for requesting South American extracts. It describes two-kilometre wind fields at five-minute intervals, with temperature, humidity and pressure at hourly resolution, derived from ERA5 with the sup3r method. The page states CC BY 4.0 and public access. This is a model-derived resource for wind-generation scenarios, not direct measurements at every prospective turbine. Reanalysis biases, generative downscaling assumptions and regional model versions are limitations for site-specific engineering estimates. A reviewer-assessed use is testing spatial and temporal wind-resource variability in electricity planning simulations. data-sup3rload is a related downscaled electricity-demand resource, with no verified synchronized grid. The describing article focuses on South America, while the provider submission also covers Ukraine. Its stated DOI resolves to a different North American WIND Toolkit record and is not assigned to this resource. No S3 object or API data extract was downloaded.
